full_name: Rosemarie Garland-Thomson | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2011–2012 Humanities Maury Green Fellow Emory University
bio: Rosemarie Garland-Thomson is a professor of women’s studies at Emory University; her fields of study are feminist theory, American literature, and disability studies.
